subject: Coffee & Tea
title: The Future of Caffeine
description: Learn The Future of Caffeine in one minute.

hook.text: Scientists are developing slow-release caffeine capsules that maintain alertness for 12 hours from a single dose.

buildup.text: Researchers are also studying caffeine analogs—molecules with the alertness benefits but none of the anxiety or sleep disruption.

discovery.text: Personalized caffeine dosing based on genetic testing is entering the consumer market through DNA kit companies.

twist.text: Synthetic biology may soon produce caffeine without any plant—brewing it like beer using engineered yeast strains.

climax.text: Caffeine has been humanity's companion for centuries. Its next chapter may be its most transformative.

punchline.text: Ancient molecule, futuristic applications. Caffeine keeps evolving.

quiz.question: What is one future caffeine innovation being developed?
options: Slow-release capsules maintaining alertness for 12 hours
